title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) in Geo-Telemetry Stream API
title_hi: जियो-टेलीमेट्री स्ट्रीम एपीआई में प्राधिकरण भेद्यता (BOLA)
business_impact: Allows authenticated low-privilege users to view and modify classified satellite surveillance feeds belonging to other agencies.
remediation: Enforce strict tenant-scoped RBAC authorization checks validating user ownership before returning node telemetry.

title: JWT Algorithm Confusion & Weak Secret Key Recovery
title_hi: जेडब्ल्यूटी एल्गोरिथम भ्रम और कमजोर गुप्त कुंजी
proof_of_concept: Tampered JWT with alg='HS256' signed using public RSA key string to forge administrative role tokens.
business_impact: Complete authentication bypass enabling arbitrary privilege escalation to System Administrator.
remediation: Hardcode verification algorithm to 'RS256' only and reject asymmetric-to-symmetric key substitutions.
